mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, author_id, parent_comment_id, reply_to_user_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, 'PUBLISHED', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE comments SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.author_id, CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NULL OR u.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE u.nickname END AS author_nickname, u.profile_image_url AS author_profile_image_url, u.profile_image_storage_key AS author_profile_image_storage_key, c.parent_comment_id, CASE WHEN ru.user_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ru.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE ru.nickname END AS reply_to_nickname, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN u.role = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS author_admin
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.author_id LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.user_id = c.reply_to_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( c.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments live_parent WHERE live_parent.comment_id = c.parent_comment_id AND live_parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND live_parent.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users hidden_author WHERE hidden_author.user_id = c.author_id AND hidden_author.status = 'SUSPENDED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments hidden_parent JOIN users hidden_parent_author ON hidden_parent_author.user_id = hidden_parent.author_id WHERE hidden_parent.comment_id = c.parent_comment_id AND hidden_parent_author.status = 'SUSPENDED' ) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( c.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments live_parent WHERE live_parent.comment_id = c.parent_comment_id AND live_parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND live_parent.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users hidden_author WHERE hidden_author.user_id = c.author_id AND hidden_author.status = 'SUSPENDED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments hidden_parent JOIN users hidden_parent_author ON hidden_parent_author.user_id = hidden_parent.author_id WHERE hidden_parent.comment_id = c.parent_comment_id AND hidden_parent_author.status = 'SUSPENDED' )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.author_id = #{authorId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.author_id = #{authorId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.comment_id, p.post_id, p.title AS post_title, c.content, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.author_id = #{authorId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
